result:
I hope tonight is soft
and quiet for you—
like a slow breath, like
a bell left ringing
in an empty room.

I hope wherever you are,
the soil remembers your steps,
and the wind carries the sound
of your name like a secret.

I hope you are held,
even when the world
feels like a fist.

I hope the moon
between the branches
drips stars into your hands.

(And if tonight is hard—
I hope you know
you are already enough.)
